name: gbbrinepond-frontend
description: 盐湖蒸发池卤水晒程编排台 - 纯前端 SPA（SolidJS + TypeScript + Vite + Solid Router + Tailwind CSS + Dexie）

scripts.test:occupancy: esbuild scripts/occupancy-engine.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.occupancy-test.cjs && node scripts/.occupancy-test.cjs && rm -f scripts/.occupancy-test.cjs
scripts.test:occupancy:db: esbuild scripts/occupancy-db.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --inject:scripts/fake-idb-env.ts --outfile=scripts/.occupancy-db-test.cjs && node scripts/.occupancy-db-test.cjs && rm -f scripts/.occupancy-db-test.cjs
scripts.test:occupancy:migrate: esbuild scripts/occupancy-migrate.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --inject:scripts/fake-idb-env.ts --outfile=scripts/.occupancy-migrate-test.cjs && node scripts/.occupancy-migrate-test.cjs && rm -f scripts/.occupancy-migrate-test.cjs
scripts.test: npm run test:occupancy && npm run test:occupancy:db && npm run test:occupancy:migrate
